name: Last Prayers of the Doomed
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: Influenced by the last prayers of the dead, creatures experience extreme claustrophobia and batter at the walls and floor, desperate to escape, see the sun, and breathe fresh air—but their prayers go unanswered.
disable: DC 26 Religion (expert) to disrupt the haunt through prayer, or DC 26 Deception or DC 26 Diplomacy DC 27 (expert) to convince the spirits you'll free them from this place

offensiveAbilities.name: Let Me Out!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the altar, corpse, or statue

Effect The triggering creature batters their fists and body into the floor and walls, dealing (4d10+18) Bludgeoning Damage damage to themself (Basic DC 25 Will Saving Throw save). All creatures who witness this become Frightened 2 unless they succeed at a Basic DC 25 Will Saving Throw save.
